Two things at once. An unknown key comes *first*, before any key the format knows about, so a
canonical writer that appends unknown keys by walking the original order has to move it to the
end rather than leaving it in front of `id`. And `created_at` carries a `+09:00` offset rather
than `Z`: the preserving path keeps the author's local-offset text, and the canonical path
normalizes it to the same instant in UTC.
